comment: The only publication switch. Every file matching the publish-manifest check's patterns must match exactly one entry here, or the gate is red: a markdown file nobody classifies is a silent omission, not an unpublished one. `public` entries name one file each, never a glob -- publication is a per-file promise, and a directory glob would ship whatever someone drops into it next. Every `public` entry must match a real file. `internal` entries may name a home and must state why the file stays in the repository; one that matches nothing is an empty shelf, not a broken promise. Patterns use fnmatch, in which '*' also matches '/'. A paired document classifies both sides: i18n.md requires the three siblings to merge whole, so shipping one language and hiding the other would break the promise the pair makes. This repository's own `README.md` is the Jellyfin Downloader user guide rather than a kit page: `tools/workflow.json` excludes it from `pairing`, so it is classified here on its own.
